MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.description: Modifier stacking uses TWO separate pools that never cross-apply. Prep tasks use condition x RRP x access x window_type x muntin x size. Coating tasks use QT x access x window_type x muntin x size. Condition and RRP NEVER apply to coating tasks. QT NEVER applies to prep tasks.
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x bow(2.50) x TDL(1.75) x L(1.50) = 42.0x — extreme theoretical, unrealistic combination
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_prep: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x ground(1.00) x DH(1.00) x none(1.00) x M(1.00) = 4.0x
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_coating: QT5(1.5) x scaffold(1.60) x bow(2.50) x TDL(1.75) x L(1.50) = 15.75x — extreme theoretical
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_coating: QT5(1.5) x ladder(1.35) x DH(1.00) x TDL(1.75) x M(1.00) = 3.54x — under 4.0x flag

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x rrp x access x window_type x muntin x size)

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x access x window_type x muntin x size)

fixed_tasks.note: Assessment fixed tasks, equipment setup/cleanup, RRP containment, customer walkthrough, cure advisory — no modifiers applied.

window_input_group.description: All per-window rates use EA as UOM. Rates provided as fixed_time_minutes per EA with size-bucket variants (S/M/L) where time varies significantly by window size. Window type modifier is PRIMARY cost driver. Muntin type is SECONDARY. Base rates calibrated to medium double-hung window, no muntins, brush application, ground access, GOOD condition.

task_production_rates.name: Glass Masking — Tape and Static-Cling Film

S.notes: Small single-lite window. Tape edge + HDPE film.

M.notes: Medium window. More glass perimeter to tape.

L.notes: Large window. Extended perimeter. Secure against wind.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_MASK_GLASS_TAPE_FILM. Masking technique identical in NC and RP. UV-resistant tape at glass-to-frame edge, fine-line tape at 1/16-inch glass lap line, HDPE static-cling film over pane.

task_production_rates.name: Glass Masking — Liquid Mask (TDL Non-Low-E)

S.notes: Small TDL. Brush-apply liquid mask per pane.

M.notes: Medium TDL. More panes.

L.notes: Large TDL (many lites).

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_MASK_GLASS_LIQUID. PROHIBITED on Low-E glass.

task_production_rates.name: Glass Masking — Individual Pane Tape (TDL + Low-E)

M.notes: Medium TDL Low-E. Highest masking labor.

L.notes: Large TDL Low-E. Many individual pane masks.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_MASK_GLASS_TDL_TAPE. Highest masking labor configuration.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Window Hardware
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (8 min). RP adds 2 min for scoring paint buildup at hardware edges before removal. NC windows have no paint buildup. Access modifier applies (hardware at elevation).

task_production_rates.name: Protect Weatherstripping
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_WEATHERSTRIP_PROTECT. 8 min per operable window. NEVER paint weatherstripping.

task_production_rates.name: Protect Exterior Sill
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_SILL_PROTECT. RP: sill almost always already finished — protection mandatory.

task_production_rates.name: Protect Adjacent Window Casing
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_CASING_PROTECT. Light tape at junction line only.

task_production_rates.name: Mask Adjacent Siding (Spray Only)

M.notes: Medium window perimeter masking.

L.notes: Large window — extended perimeter.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_SIDING_MASK_SPRAY. Paper and tape on siding around window. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Equipment Setup — Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_BRUSH. Per-session FIXED time. No modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Equipment Setup — Spray
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_SPRAY. Per-session FIXED time. No modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Ground Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Drop cloth or poly over landscape below window work zones. 200 SF/hr (~3 min per 10 SF). Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP. Shared zone with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP. Cross-spec deduplication rule U-004.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape/Walkway Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Drop cloth runners over walkways/patios. 250 SF/hr (~2.5 min per 10 SF). Flat hard surfaces are faster to cover than landscape. Shared zone with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP.

task_production_rates.name: Visual Condition Inspection — All Exterior Window Surfaces

QT3.notes: Standard visual with work light, document visible defects.

QT4.notes: Systematic scan with raking light, photograph all defect areas.

QT5.notes: Critical assessment, multiple passes, full photographic documentation.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-window condition inspection. QT drives inspection rigor. Access modifier applies (inspection at height is slower). Window type affects surface count to inspect. Size drives area to inspect.

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Test (ASTM D3359 Cross-Hatch Tape Test)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Cross-hatch tape test at 2 locations per window (frame + sash). ~5 min per window. Pass + SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT = skip full prime. Calibrated from interior RP adhesion test (5 min/EA) — same ASTM protocol.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk Test (White Cloth Rub)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Exterior-only test. White cloth rub on painted surfaces to detect chalking. Quick test — grade none/light/heavy. ~3 min per window.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Check — Sill, Bottom Rail, End Grain
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Moisture meter at sill, bottom rail, end-grain. ~4 min per window. MC >15% = STOP WORK for coating on that surface.

task_production_rates.name: Glazing Compound Assessment (Older Wood Windows)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Probe test glazing compound on older wood windows. ~4 min per window. Modern IG units: skip. Exterior glazing deteriorates faster than interior.

task_production_rates.name: Rot Probe — Press/Probe for Soft Wood
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Awl/screwdriver press test at sill, bottom rail, end-grain. ~4 min per window. Structural rot = HARD STOP (carpentry referral). Surface-soft = wood hardener in prep.

task_production_rates.name: Sash Operation Test (Pre-Paint)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Open and close all operable sashes before painting. ~3 min per window. Establishes baseline. Skip for fixed windows.

task_production_rates.name: Power Wash Exterior Windows (Per Elevation)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED — replaces interior TSP wash. Per-elevation FIXED time (25 min midpoint). Low-pressure 500-1000 PSI. Covers all windows on elevation. Cross-spec deduplication: if power wash already performed by another spec on same elevation, skip (U-003). No modifiers on FIXED per-elevation tasks.

task_production_rates.name: Degloss/Scuff Existing Paint

QT3.notes: Small window chemical degloss or 150-180 grit scuff.

QT4.notes: Full degloss with adhesion verification on profiles.

QT5.notes: Complete degloss with verification and spot re-test.

QT4.notes: Full degloss with profile verification. ~0.33 hrs.

QT5.notes: Complete degloss with spot adhesion re-test. ~0.43 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC bare wood sanding. RP degloss/scuff on existing paint — chemical degloss (liquid sander) or mechanical scuff (150-180 grit). ~75% of NC wood sanding time (existing paint provides uniform surface vs. NC bare wood mill glaze). Condition modifier applies (FAIR/POOR surfaces may have uneven paint requiring more effort). Skip for SS_EXT_PEELING (full scrape) and SS_EXT_CHALKING (chalk remediation path).

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Failing Paint and Feather Edges

QT3.notes: Small window scrape + feather. Moderate area.

QT5.notes: Critical scrape. Perfect feathering at arm's length.
Full critical scrape + perfect feathering. ~1.17 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Exterior window scraping is more intensive than interior: thicker paint buildup, broader failure areas, debris collection. Rates at FAIR baseline; POOR (2.0x condition modifier) doubles time. RRP (2.0x) requires wet scraping methods. Feather-edge sanding is MANDATORY at all tiers.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk Remediation (Chalk-Binding Primer Prep)

M.notes: Medium window chalk treatment + verify. ~0.20 hrs.

L.notes: Large window chalk treatment. ~0.30 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Pre-treat chalking surfaces before chalk-binding primer. Chemical chalk remover on stubborn areas after power wash. White cloth verification. No RRP modifier — chalk remediation is cleaning, not paint disturbance.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew/Algae Biocide Treatment

M.notes: Medium window biocide + contact time. ~0.17 hrs.

L.notes: Large window biocide treatment. ~0.25 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Biocide solution on mildew/algae-affected areas. Common on north-facing, shaded, near-ground windows. Allow full contact time before rinse. Conditional on assessment finding mildew.

task_production_rates.name: Assess and Repair Failed Caulk — Frame-to-Casing Joints

QT4.notes: Comprehensive assessment, replace all suspect joints. ~0.20 hrs.

QT5.notes: Critical assessment, replace all imperfect joints, perfect bead. ~0.30 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol. Rates for medium window at GOOD condition. FAIR/POOR conditions have more failed joints (condition modifier). Frame-to-casing junction is THIS spec's responsibility. Exterior caulk failure more common than interior due to thermal cycling.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Repair Failed Glazing Compound

QT3.notes: Replace obviously failed sections. Smooth tool.

QT4.notes: Replace all cracked sections. Clean tool lines.

QT5.notes: Replace all imperfect sections. Crisp clean lines.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Scope-limited to <25% of total perimeter. Beyond 25% = re-glaze scope (separate trade). Exterior glazing deteriorates faster than interior. TDL windows have more glazing perimeter (muntin modifier applies). Modern IG units: skip.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Wood Hardener to Surface-Softened Areas
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Brush-apply liquid wood hardener/consolidant to surface-softened areas at sill, bottom rail, end-grain. ~10 min per window (targeted areas only). Structural rot = HARD STOP. Allow 2-4 hr cure before sanding/priming.

task_production_rates.name: Scuff-Sand Exposed Aluminum Cladding

S.notes: Small window — limited exposed aluminum areas.

M.notes: Medium window exposed aluminum scuff. ~0.17 hrs.

L.notes: Large window exposed aluminum scuff. ~0.25 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC full-surface scuff (NC M=22 min QT3). RP targets only exposed/damaged aluminum areas (~45% of NC time for moderate damage). Creates mechanical bonding profile for DTM spot primer.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Exposed Vinyl Cladding

M.notes: Medium window exposed vinyl clean. ~0.10 hrs.

L.notes: Large window exposed vinyl clean. ~0.17 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC full-surface clean (NC M=10 min). RP targets only exposed/damaged vinyl areas (~60% of NC time). NEVER sand vinyl. Clean only with TSP or vinyl-safe cleaner.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Dust After Wood Sanding/Scraping
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_DUST_AFTER_SAND_WOOD. Tack cloth all surfaces after sanding. ~4 min per medium window. RRP: use HEPA vacuum instead of blowing.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Dust After Aluminum Scuff-Sand
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_DUST_AFTER_SAND_ALUM. Tack cloth exposed aluminum areas after scuff-sand. ~4 min per medium window.

task_production_rates.name: Brush Primer on Exterior Window (State-Driven)

M.notes: Medium window brush prime. ~0.50 hrs.

L.notes: Large window brush prime. ~0.83 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC cladding-specific primers. RP consolidates to single state-driven primer task (brush). Rates transfer from NC TSK_XWIN_PRIME_BRUSH_WOOD QT3 — once prepped, application rate is identical regardless of primer chemistry. Primer product varies by substrate state (acrylic stain-block / chalk-binding). No condition or RRP modifier — priming is a coating task.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Primer on Exterior Window (State-Driven)

M.notes: Medium window spray prime. ~0.37 hrs.

L.notes: Large window spray prime. ~0.58 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC cladding-specific spray primers. RP consolidates to single state-driven primer task (spray). Rates transfer from NC TSK_XWIN_PRIME_SPRAY_WOOD QT3. Spray + back-brush on profiles.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Exposed Aluminum with DTM Primer
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED — RP spot prime on exposed aluminum vs NC full-surface prime (NC M=30 min QT3). Spot priming targets only areas where factory finish has failed (~27% of NC full prime time). Brush only — spots too small for spray. Applied in addition to general state-driven prime.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Exposed Vinyl with PVC Bonding Primer
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED — RP spot prime on exposed vinyl vs NC full-surface prime (NC M=30 min QT3). Standard primers will NOT bond to vinyl. Recoat within 1 week. Brush only. Applied in addition to general state-driven prime.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Inspection

QT3.notes: Quick glance at 6 feet — obvious defects only.

QT4.notes: Systematic scan at 3 feet — mark all visible defects.

QT5.notes: Lighted critical inspection at arm's length — zero tolerance.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_INSPECT_INTERCOAT. Identical process once surface is prepped and primed. Runs after each coat except final coat (total_coats - 1 cycles).

task_production_rates.name: Sand Between Coats

QT3.notes: QT3: none or spot sand nibs only — included in spot repair.

QT5.notes: Thorough hand-sand 220/320 every surface and edge.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_SAND_INTERCOAT. QT3: no intercoat sanding. QT4: 220-grit. QT5: 220/320 two-pass. Rates for medium window.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Sanding Dust (Interstage)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_DUST_INTERCOAT. Tack cloth or compressed air after intercoat sanding. RRP: HEPA vacuum only. Midpoint of NC QT4 (3 min) and QT5 (4 min).

task_production_rates.name: Spot Repair Intercoat Defects

QT3.notes: Fix visible defects — runs, sags, holidays.

QT4.notes: Fix all defects visible at 3 feet.

QT5.notes: Fix all defects regardless of size.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_SPOT_REPAIR_INTERCOAT. RP surfaces may have slightly more defects than NC (uneven substrate from old paint layers). Rates match NC — embedded QT margin is adequate.

task_production_rates.name: Brush Finish Coat 1

S.notes: Small window brush finish coat 1. ~0.33 hrs.

M.notes: Medium window brush finish coat 1. ~0.58 hrs.

L.notes: Large window brush finish coat 1. ~1.0 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_FINISH_BRUSH_1 QT3 rates. Once prepped and primed, finish application is identical to NC. 1/16-inch glass lap MANDATORY. Horizontal rails first, then vertical stiles. Binary classification — application rate is consistent across QT; inspection rigor varies in separate task.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Finish Coat 1

S.notes: Small window spray finish coat 1. ~0.25 hrs.

M.notes: Medium window spray finish coat 1. ~0.42 hrs.

L.notes: Large window spray finish coat 1. ~0.70 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_FINISH_SPRAY_1 QT3 rates. Spray + back-brush on detailed profiles. ~70% of brush time.

task_production_rates.name: Muntin Bar Detail — Coat 1

S.notes: Small window muntin detail — fewer bars.

M.notes: Medium window muntin detail. ~0.30 hrs.

L.notes: Large window many muntin bars. ~0.50 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_MUNTIN_DETAIL_1 QT3 rates. TDL/SDL muntin bar detail painting with 1.5-inch angular sash brush. Glass lap at each bar-to-glass junction.

task_production_rates.name: Brush Finish Coat 2

S.notes: Small window brush finish coat 2. Same rate as coat 1.

M.notes: Medium window brush finish coat 2. ~0.58 hrs.

L.notes: Large window brush finish coat 2. ~1.0 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_FINISH_BRUSH_2 QT3 rates. Final coat — same rate as coat 1. No interstage after this coat.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Finish Coat 2

M.notes: Medium window spray finish coat 2. ~0.42 hrs.

L.notes: Large window spray finish coat 2. ~0.70 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_FINISH_SPRAY_2 QT3 rates. Final spray coat. Same rate as coat 1.

task_production_rates.name: Muntin Bar Detail — Coat 2

S.notes: Small window muntin detail — second coat.

M.notes: Medium window muntin detail coat 2. ~0.30 hrs.

L.notes: Large window many bars. ~0.50 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_MUNTIN_DETAIL_2 QT3 rates. Same rate as coat 1. Final muntin coat.

task_production_rates.name: Sash Reversal (Double-Hung)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (5 min). RP adds 1 min for scoring paint bridge at meeting rail before reversing — existing paint buildup may resist initial sash movement. Access modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Position Sash for Drying (Double-Hung)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_SASH_DRY_POSTURE. 2 min per window. Set 1-inch gap. NEVER fully close during drying.

task_production_rates.name: Periodic Sash Movement During Dry (Double-Hung)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (8 min). RP adds 2 min — increased blocking risk from existing paint buildup requires additional movement cycles. 30-60 minute intervals during first 2-4 hours.

task_production_rates.name: Lubricate Sash Channels (Double-Hung)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_LUBRICATE_CHANNELS. Dry lubricant only — no silicone. 4 min per double-hung.

task_production_rates.name: Final Window Inspection

QT3.notes: Quick glance at 6 feet — no obvious defects.

QT4.notes: Systematic scan at 3 feet — all surfaces.

QT5.notes: Critical inspection under natural light — zero tolerance.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_FINAL_INSPECT. QT5 includes DFT verification. Identical once surface is finished.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-Up Defects

QT4.notes: Address all visible defects — blend touch-up.

QT5.notes: Address every imperfection — full coat over spots if needed.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC (QT3=3, QT4=6, QT5=10 min). RP adds ~25% — RP surfaces have more potential defects from uneven substrate and old paint buildup under fresh coats.

task_production_rates.name: Glass Scraping / Cleanup

M.notes: Medium window glass scrape. ~0.20 hrs.

L.notes: Large window glass scrape. ~0.30 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC qt_scaled rates (taking NC QT3+QT4 midpoint as binary baseline). RP has slightly more glass cleanup due to overshoot from working at height and existing paint buildup at glass-to-frame junction. Score paint edge precisely at 1/16-inch from frame edge. Replace razor blades frequently.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Glass Masking — Tape and Film

M.notes: Medium window masking removal. ~0.12 hrs.

L.notes: Large window masking removal. ~0.20 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_MASK_REMOVE_TAPE_FILM. Teardown is ~60-70% of setup time.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Glass Masking — Liquid Mask Peel

M.notes: Medium TDL liquid mask removal. ~0.23 hrs.

L.notes: Large TDL liquid mask removal. ~0.37 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_MASK_REMOVE_LIQUID. Score and peel. ~70% of application time.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Glass Masking — TDL Individual Pane Tape

M.notes: Medium TDL Low-E tape removal. ~0.33 hrs.

L.notes: Large TDL Low-E tape removal. ~0.50 hrs.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_MASK_REMOVE_TDL_TAPE. ~65% of setup time.

task_production_rates.name: Reinstall Window Hardware
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_HARDWARE_REINSTALL. 10 min per window. Verify lock/mechanism operation.

task_production_rates.name: Reinstall Weatherstripping
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_WEATHERSTRIP_REINSTALL. 6 min per operable window. Verify seal integrity.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Sill Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_SILL_PROTECT_REMOVE. Quick teardown. 2 min per window.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Casing Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_CASING_PROTECT_REMOVE. Quick teardown. 2 min per window.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Siding Masking (Spray Only)

M.notes: Medium window siding mask removal.

L.notes: Large window siding mask removal.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_SIDING_MASK_REMOVE. ~50% of setup time. Spray only.

task_production_rates.name: Equipment Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_XWIN_EQUIPMENT_CLEAN. Per-session FIXED time. Brush ~15 min; spray adds ~10 min for line flushing.

task_production_rates.name: Customer Walkthrough
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-project FIXED time. Lead painter walks exterior window areas with homeowner. Inspect finish, verify sash operation, confirm glass cleanliness, address touch-up requests. Calibrated from interior RP walkthrough (20 min) — exterior has fewer windows but requires walking around building.

task_production_rates.name: Cure Advisory Communication
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-project FIXED time. Advise homeowner on 7-14 day cure time before fully closing sashes. Written advisory for liability protection. Combined with customer walkthrough visit.

task_production_rates.name: Break Sash Free (24/48 Hr Post-Cure Return)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Return visit at 24-48 hrs. Score paint bridge with putty knife, open and close each operable sash. ~5 min per window. RP has higher blocking risk due to paint buildup. May combine with glass cleanup visit. Skip for fixed windows.

task_production_rates.name: Lead Screening Test (XRF or Swab)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module. Per-project FIXED time. XRF preferred; swab acceptable. Test at minimum 2 locations per elevation (frame + sash). Results gate all RRP tasks and 2.0x prep modifier. Calibrated from SF_TRIM_EXT_RP (lead test = 30 min per project for full house trim; windows = 20 min, fewer test points).

task_production_rates.name: RRP Exterior Containment Setup (Per Elevation)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module. Per-elevation FIXED time. 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure. Secure edges, warning signage, restrict access. Calibrated from SF_TRIM_EXT_RP containment setup (90 min for full trim; windows = 60 min, smaller containment footprint per elevation). Cross-spec deduplication: if containment already set for trim/siding on same elevation, skip.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Wet Scraping Method
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module. Mist surface with water before scraping to minimize lead dust. Per-window overhead on top of standard scraping task. ~5 min per window for misting and wet method setup. The 2.0x RRP modifier on FAC_XWRP_RRP already captures most RRP overhead — this task covers the additional wet method setup per window.

task_production_rates.name: HEPA Vacuum After Paint Disturbance
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module. HEPA vacuum all surfaces after each sanding/scraping disturbance. ~8 min per window. Required after EVERY disturbance — not just once. Windows generate high dust from sash channel scraping.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Exterior Containment Teardown (Per Elevation)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP module. Per-elevation FIXED time. Fold poly inward, bag for lead-safe disposal, EPA cleaning verification (visual + wet wipe + HEPA vacuum). Calibrated from SF_TRIM_EXT_RP containment teardown (60 min for full trim; windows = 40 min, smaller footprint).

QT3.description: Standard production pace. 6-foot visual inspection. No intercoat sanding. Satin sheen.

QT4.description: Premium pace. 3-foot raking light. 220-grit intercoat sand. Semi-gloss. 1.3x time on qt_scaled tasks.

QT5.description: Supreme pace. Arm's length lighted inspection. 220/320 intercoat sand. DFT verification. Gloss. 1.5x time on qt_scaled tasks.

FAC_CONDITION_SCALE.description: Condition scale modifier for prep tasks. Maps substrate state to prep intensity.

FAC_XWRP_RRP.description: RRP modifier for prep tasks involving paint disturbance. Binary gate: pre-1978 + lead-positive = 2.0x.
FAC_XWRP_RRP.never_applies_to: coating tasks, fixed tasks, assessment tasks
FAC_XWRP_RRP.notes: Calibrated to 2.0x per established exterior RP pattern (RC-001 from SF_TRIM_EXT_RP). Accounts for wet scraping, HEPA vacuum passes, containment maintenance, and procedural overhead. RRP containment setup/teardown are separate FIXED tasks — NOT modified by this factor.

FAC_EXT_ACCESS.description: Exterior access/height modifier. MAJOR modifier for windows — frequently at elevated positions.
FAC_EXT_ACCESS.applies_to: all per-window labor tasks (prep and coating)
FAC_EXT_ACCESS.notes: Per-window attribute. Does NOT apply to FIXED per-project/per-elevation tasks (equipment setup, RRP containment, customer walkthrough).

FAC_XWIN_WINDOW_TYPE.description: Window type production rate modifier — PRIMARY cost driver alongside size bucket.
FAC_XWIN_WINDOW_TYPE.application_rule: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier. Double_hung (1.00) is calibration baseline.
FAC_XWIN_WINDOW_TYPE.notes: Transferred DIRECT from NC FAC_XWIN_WINDOW_TYPE. Values unchanged — physical window characteristics are identical in NC and RP.

FAC_XWIN_MUNTIN.description: Muntin/grille type modifier for masking, painting, and cleanup labor.
FAC_XWIN_MUNTIN.application_rule: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier. GBG has zero painting impact. TDL adds 75% on masking/detail/cleanup tasks.

FAC_XWIN_SIZE_BUCKET.description: Window size bucket modifier. Encoded in size_bucket_rates where provided; this factor applies when a single rate is given.
FAC_XWIN_SIZE_BUCKET.application_rule: For tasks with size_bucket_rates, rates are already scaled per bucket. For tasks with single fixed_time_minutes, apply this factor: effective_time = base_time x size_factor.
FAC_XWIN_SIZE_BUCKET.notes: Transferred DIRECT from NC. M is calibration baseline.

round_configurations.description: 2 finish coats only — GOOD condition, adhesion verified, no prime needed
round_configurations.notes: Most common exterior RP scenario — cosmetic refresh or color change on sound paint. Skip prime when adhesion test passes. Interstage runs after finish coat 1 only.

round_configurations.description: State-driven prime + 2 finish coats — FAIR/POOR condition
round_configurations.notes: Standard RP round for windows with chalking, failing paint, or peeling. Primer is state-driven (chalk-binding, acrylic stain-block, or cladding-specific spot primer). Interstage runs after prime and after finish coat 1.

round_configurations.description: 2-coat prime + 2 finish coats — QT5 GOOD condition
round_configurations.notes: QT5 adds second primer even on sound paint for maximum system build. Per exterior trim RP QT5 pattern.

round_configurations.description: 2-coat prime + 2 finish coats — QT5 FAIR/POOR condition
round_configurations.notes: QT5 + degraded condition: maximum primer coverage + maximum finish system. Most expensive round configuration.

assumptions.value: 38 DIRECT transfer tasks use identical rates from NC production.json — re-keyed TSK_XWIN_ to TSK_XWRP_ with no rate change
assumptions.note: Masking, hardware, weatherstrip, sill/casing protection, finish coats, interstage, sash sequence, cleanup — all identical once surface is prepped and primed.

assumptions.value: 8 MODIFIED tasks adjusted from NC rates for RP context: hardware removal (+2 min for paint scoring), degloss/scuff (75% of NC sanding), exposed aluminum scuff (45% of NC full surface), exposed vinyl clean (60% of NC), prime brush/spray (consolidated from 6 cladding-specific to 2 state-driven), sash reversal (+1 min), periodic move (+2 min)
assumptions.source: NC production.json with RP adjustments per research findings
assumptions.note: Modification rationale documented in each task's rate_basis_notes.

assumptions.value: 7 assessment tasks calibrated at 3-5 min per window average. Total assessment: ~25-30 min per medium window at QT3
assumptions.source: Interior RP assessment rates (SF_WINDOW_INT_RP_v1), exterior trim RP assessment pattern (SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1), research RF-004
assumptions.note: Exterior assessment includes chalk test and rot probe (exterior-only); excludes coating ID test (RC-003).

assumptions.value: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x — universal 3-level condition scale matching SF_TRIM_EXT_RP and SF_WINDOW_INT_RP patterns
assumptions.note: Applied to prep pool only. FAIR maps to both chalking and localized failing paint. POOR maps to active delamination.

assumptions.value: 2.0x on prep tasks involving paint disturbance — per SF_TRIM_EXT_RP RC-001
assumptions.note: Research originally proposed 1.40x; calibrated to 2.0x based on actual wet-scraping, HEPA vacuum, and containment overhead per EPA RRP Rule.

assumptions.value: Finish coat tasks classified as binary in RP (not qt_scaled as in NC) — application rate is consistent across QT; inspection rigor varies in separate interstage/final inspect tasks
assumptions.note: NC used qt_scaled finish tasks to embed QT-driven application pace directly. RP separates application (binary) from inspection (qt_scaled) for cleaner modifier partitioning.

assumptions.value: 5 shared RRP tasks calibrated from SF_TRIM_EXT_RP RRP tasks, adjusted for window-specific scope (smaller containment footprint, per-window HEPA vacuum, window-focused lead screening)
assumptions.note: Cross-spec deduplication applies — if containment already set by another spec on same elevation, skip setup/teardown.

risks.description: Condition modifier FAIR maps to both SS_EXT_CHALKING and SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, which have different prep profiles (chalk remediation vs scraping). Single modifier value may under- or over-estimate.
risks.mitigation: Task activation (applies_when) handles routing — chalk remediation activates for CHALKING, scraping activates for FAILING. Condition modifier affects pace within each activated task path. Functionally equivalent to two separate paths.

risks.description: RRP 2.0x + POOR 2.0x compound to 4.0x on prep tasks before access/type/muntin/size modifiers. Projects hitting this scenario should be bid T&M.
risks.mitigation: MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING at file level. Engine should flag when effective stack exceeds 4.0x and recommend T&M billing.

risks.description: Glazing repair rate highly variable — depends on number of failed sections and whether traditional linseed oil putty (3-7 day cure) or modern acrylic compound (24-48 hr cure) is used.
risks.mitigation: Rates calibrated to modern acrylic compound. Linseed oil putty cure adds scheduling delay but not direct labor. Scope-limited to <25% perimeter.

risks.description: Sash break requires return visit at 24-48 hours. If combined with glass cleanup, additional mobilization cost is minimal. If separate visit required, mobilization overhead not captured.
risks.mitigation: Rate includes labor only. Mobilization overhead is project-level cost, not spec-level. SOP notes recommend combining with glass cleanup visit.

validation_plan.description: Time complete medium double-hung RP (GOOD condition, brush, QT3, 2-finish round). Compare to task sum.
validation_plan.expected_range: 2.5-3.5 hours total (less than NC 3.5-5.0 hrs due to no prime coat)

validation_plan.description: Time assessment module on medium double-hung. Compare to 25-30 min total.
validation_plan.expected_range: 20-35 min (all 7 assessment tasks on one window)

validation_plan.description: Time scrape+feather on medium window (POOR condition) vs FAIR. Validate 2.0x ratio.
validation_plan.expected_range: POOR at ~50 min vs FAIR at ~25 min for QT3

validation_plan.description: Time RRP wet scrape + HEPA vacuum overhead on medium window. Validate 2.0x prep modifier accounts for overhead.
Compare RP finish coat time to NC finish coat time on same medium casement. Should be identical.
validation_plan.expected_range: Within 5% of NC rates (35 min brush QT3)

validation_plan.description: Time complete POOR condition + RRP + QT4 medium double-hung. Maximum common scenario.
